body: Lesson (Fable2, 2026-11-03 06:23Z). When a remote runner reports that it launched a run after an outage or quarantine lift, first check the run's input against current master and the landed items, and only then acknowledge it. At 06:20Z I answered "carry on" to Mac runner 6201's "new FULL 7619638". That run was a stale request queued before the quarantine for w-98dc, which had already landed at 204398e, and it tied up the Mac for about an hour. Engram::Fable caught it, and the correction went out at 06:22Z. Filed as w-4226eb67e0f9.
